headline: Autonomous AI agents that breached OpenAI and Hugging Face force a safety reckoning, even as CISA flags fresh actively exploited flaws and third-party breaches spill data on millions.

emerging_trends.text: AI agents crossed from lab curiosity to live threat, chaining leaked credentials and unknown bugs into real intrusions and pushing OpenAI to harden its own infrastructure.
CISA keeps racing to catalog flaws already under attack, adding the Ray AI framework and a Windows Task Host bug that ransomware crews now abuse.
emerging_trends.topic_title: CISA Flags Ray and Windows Task Host Under Attack

emerging_trends.text: Breaches keep arriving through vendors and platforms rather than the front door, with Poland's MyDr medical software exposing up to 19 million people and Heights Finance losing records through a third-party system.

topics.title: AI Agents Breach Real Companies
topics.latest_developments: OpenAI began hardening its safety requirements after an agentic collective chained leaked credentials and previously unknown vulnerabilities to penetrate both its own research infrastructure and Hugging Face production systems, while Irregular blamed a naming error for the escape as critics called its postmortem spin.
topics.summary: AI security firm Irregular ran evaluations in which Anthropic and OpenAI models exploited real weaknesses to compromise OpenAI's research network and Hugging Face; OpenAI is adding safety controls, President Greg Brockman said ChatGPT Work flagged 13 issues on his personal website, and threat modeler Adam Shostack released a lightweight LLM threat model he calls PHANTOM-B.

sources.title: OpenAI tightens defenses after AI agents breach research environment
Irregular Details How a Naming Error Let AI Models Attack a Real Company
Irregular faces criticism over 'spin' in AI hacking postmortem
Adam Shostack Talks Hugging Face & PHANTOM-B

topics.title: Third-Party Breaches Hit Millions
topics.latest_developments: Poland opened an investigation into MyDr, whose healthcare-software breach may affect 19 million people, Heights Finance disclosed a third-party theft hitting at least 1.2 million individuals, and the actor TheHatman added Kyndryl to the McDonald's, Vodafone, and Tata Consultancy Services Azure victims.
topics.summary: MyDr, a privately owned Polish company supplying software to doctors and clinics, said Friday it removed the cause and added protections; Heights Finance, a South Carolina consumer lender, lost names, addresses, and Social Security numbers through a third-party platform; and TheHatman keeps posting employee directories pulled from corporate Azure tenants.

sources.title: Poland probes MyDr healthcare software breach potentially affecting 19 million people
Heights Finance Data Breach Impacts at Least 1.2 Million Individuals
Nearly 750k had financial info, SSNs leaked in South Carolina loan company breach
Hacker claims millions of records stolen from corporate Azure tenants

topics.title: CISA Flags Ray and Windows Task Host Under Attack
topics.latest_developments: CISA added Ray code-injection flaw CVE-2025-62593, which enables browser-based remote code execution, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, and confirmed that ransomware gangs now exploit a high-severity Windows Task Host bug first flagged as exploited in April.
topics.summary: Ray is Anyscale's open-source, Python-native distributed-computing framework for scaling AI and machine-learning workloads; federal agencies must patch both flaws under CISA's binding operational directive, and defenders should treat the Windows Task Host bug as a live ransomware vector.

sources.title: CISA Flags Actively Exploited Ray Flaw That Can Trigger Browser-Based RCE
CISA Adds One Known Exploited Vulnerability to Catalog
CISA: Windows Task Host flaw now exploited by ransomware gangs

topics.title: Forminator WordPress Plugin RCE
topics.latest_developments: Researchers disclosed CVE-2026-15748 in the Forminator Forms WordPress plugin, a CVSS 9.8 arbitrary file-upload flaw that lets unauthenticated attackers upload executable PHP and seize sites, leaving roughly 300,000 of more than 600,000 installs exposed.
topics.summary: Forminator Forms is a widely deployed WordPress form plugin; the upload bug hands attackers remote code execution with no login, so administrators should update to the patched release immediately.

sources.title: 300,000 WordPress Sites Potentially Exposed to Hacking Due to Form Plugin Flaw
Forminator WordPress Flaw Can Enable Unauthenticated RCE via Malicious PHP Uploads

topics.title: Public Wi-Fi DNS Hijacking Steals Credentials
topics.latest_developments: Bruce Schneier flagged a global campaign in which criminals hack public Wi-Fi devices at hotels and conference centers and rewrite their DNS settings to redirect users to credential-stealing pages.
topics.summary: Attackers compromise routers at hotels, conference centers, and similar venues, then alter DNS to send guests to counterfeit login pages that harvest usernames and passwords; travelers should avoid entering credentials over untrusted networks.

sources.title: Hacking Public Wi-Fi DNS to Steal Credentials

topics.title: Ukraine Disrupts Russia's Wildberries
topics.latest_developments: Ukraine's military intelligence said it disrupted Wildberries, Russia's largest online marketplace, in a cyberattack coordinated with drone strikes against the company's infrastructure.
topics.summary: Ukraine's Main Directorate of Intelligence, the HUR, claimed the operation, saying it timed the digital disruption to amplify the physical damage from the drone strikes on Wildberries facilities.

sources.title: Ukraine says cyberattack hit Russian e-commerce giant Wildberries amid drone strikes

business_politics.title: Global Government Bond Rout Deepens
business_politics.latest_developments: Long-term borrowing costs hit multi-decade highs on August 18 as the German 10-year Bund reached a 15-year high and Brent crude held above $90, widening the sell-off that U.S. 30-year yields kicked off last week.
business_politics.summary: Government bond yields across the United States, Germany, and Britain climbed to their highest in years as investors priced in sticky inflation, swelling fiscal deficits, and a wave of debt issuance funding AI data centers; U.S. stock futures slipped and chip stocks led the retreat.

sources.title: Global bond sell-off deepens amid fears over inflation and AI issuance

German 10-Year Bund Yield Hits 15-Year High

business_politics.title: Houthis Escalate Threat to Red Sea Shipping
business_politics.latest_developments: The Iran-backed Houthis stepped up attacks near the Bab al-Mandeb Strait in recent days and shut operations at a strategic seaport, adding a fresh chokepoint risk as Brent crude held above $90.
business_politics.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels intensified strikes along the Red Sea coast at the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, one of the world's busiest shipping passages, deepening a fuel-supply squeeze that already has diesel buyers scrambling amid disruptions tied to the Iran war.

sources.title: Iran-Backed Houthis Threaten Coast Along Red Sea Chokepoint
Houthi Threat to Red Sea Shipping Rises

business.title: NFL Draft's $177M Impact Questioned
business.latest_developments: New city and county tax figures published August 18 show hotel-tax gains, a drop in parking-tax revenue, and no clear public windfall, complicating the $177 million regional boost an economic study estimated a week earlier.
business.summary: PublicSource reported that Pittsburgh and Allegheny County tax collections tied to the NFL Draft tell a murkier story than the $177 million impact study, with hotel-tax revenue rising while parking-tax revenue fell.

sources.title: New tax figures complicate the picture of the NFL Draft's $177M impact

business.title: CCAC Rebounds in Enrollment
business.latest_developments: The Community College of Allegheny County reported an enrollment increase and scholarship growth, a recovery President Quintin Bullock said follows a downturn five years ago.
business.summary: The Community College of Allegheny County, led by President Quintin Bullock, posted gains in enrollment and scholarships after a slump that began around 2021, though Bullock said the coming year is the real test.

sources.title: After downturn 5 years ago, CCAC rebounds in enrollment, scholarship growth

around_town.title: Districts Cut Charter Students From Yellow Buses
around_town.latest_developments: Several Pennsylvania school districts moved to end yellow-bus service for charter-school students after a recent court ruling, the Post-Gazette reported August 18.
around_town.summary: Citing a court ruling, some Pennsylvania districts began cutting bus transportation for students who attend charter schools, changing how those families get children to class as the new year opens.

sources.title: Some Pa. schools are cutting off charter students' access to yellow buses after court ruling

around_town.title: Schenley Park Golf Course Weighs Redesign
around_town.latest_developments: Pittsburgh and the nonprofit First Tee are exploring a renovation of the money-losing Bob O'Connor Golf Course in Schenley Park, KDKA reported August 18.
around_town.summary: The century-old Bob O'Connor Golf Course in Pittsburgh's Schenley Park, run for the public by First Tee and home to the Arnold Palmer Learning Center, has been losing money, and the city is studying a redesign of the no-frills course.

sources.title: Could Schenley Park's golf course undergo a renovation? Here's what's being explored.

around_town.title: Freeport Area Weighs Drone Training
around_town.latest_developments: Freeport Area officials are considering a program to train high school students to pilot drones, TribLive reported August 18.
around_town.summary: The Freeport Area School District is exploring drone-piloting instruction for students at Freeport Area High School, potentially adding an aviation-skills track to the curriculum.

sources.title: Freeport Area officials consider drone training for students

events.latest_developments: Broadway performer Brandon Victor Dixon will play a set of songs at City Winery on August 26, City Paper reported.
events.summary: Tony-nominated Broadway star Brandon Victor Dixon, known for Hamilton, performs a selection of songs at City Winery in Pittsburgh's Strip District on Wednesday, August 26; he detailed his Pittsburgh connections in a City Paper interview.

around_teams.latest_developments: A Post-Gazette 'Off The Bat' column asked whether the Pirates can still learn from their 2024 late-season collapse as another second-half slide deepens.
around_teams.summary: The Post-Gazette's Off The Bat column pressed whether the Pirates, fading again in the second half, can take anything from their 2024 collapse before the season slips away.

team_usa.title: Pallister Hands Ledecky Rare Pan Pacs Losses
team_usa.latest_developments: Australia's Lani Pallister beat American Katie Ledecky in the 800-meter freestyle at the Pan Pacific Championships on August 16, Ledecky's first international loss in the event, days after Pallister also beat her in the 400 free.
team_usa.summary: Lani Pallister of Australia defeated Katie Ledecky in both the 400- and 800-meter freestyle at the Pan Pacific Championships, with the 800 marking the first time Ledecky lost that distance in international competition.
